title: perf(action): cache the built scanner across Action runs
problem: The composite Action rebuilds the scanner on every run, adding minutes to each workflow.
why: Caching the build makes the Action practical for large organizations.
scope: Add a target-directory cache keyed on the Action ref and Cargo.lock.
guidance: Prefer GitHub's cache action; fall back gracefully when the cache is unavailable.
tests: Observed in CI on repeated runs
security: Never cache secrets; cache only build outputs from trusted refs.

title: feat(action): document and test Action outputs
problem: The Action exposes an exit code output but consumers need counts and the SARIF path.
why: Outputs let downstream steps make decisions without re-parsing.
scope: Add outputs for finding counts and the report path, and document each.
guidance: Derive outputs from the JSON report already produced.
acceptance: Outputs documented and consumed by an example workflow
security: Do not expose secrets through outputs.

title: docs(action): prepare the Action for Marketplace publication
problem: The Action lacks the metadata and documentation needed for Marketplace listing.
why: Marketplace visibility is a major adoption channel.
scope: Review name, description, branding, and add an Action-specific README section with examples.

title: feat(ci): add push scanning on main with baseline update
problem: There is a PR scan but no main-branch scan, so post-merge drift is invisible.
why: Main-branch scanning catches drift and keeps the baseline accurate.
scope: Add a main-branch workflow that scans, uploads SARIF, and optionally updates the baseline on a schedule.
guidance: Keep baseline updates reviewable; never force-push.
acceptance: Workflow runs on push to main

title: test(github): add workflow-injection hardening tests
problem: Annotations and comments incorporate finding text and file paths that could contain workflow-command or shell metacharacters.
why: Untrusted source content flows into CI output and could inject commands or break steps.
scope: Test that annotations and comments escape special characters, and add a fuzz-style test for tricky inputs.
guidance: Escape before emitting workflow commands; prefer JSON parsing over string interpolation.
acceptance: Escaping verified for paths, titles, and evidence
tests: Unit tests plus documented manual verification
security: This is the central CI injection surface; treat as high priority.

title: fix(github): handle changed-file edge cases in PR scanning
problem: The changed-file step does not account for renames, deletions, and submodules, so it may scan missing or stale paths.
why: Incorrect file lists cause false confidence or skipped analysis.
scope: Filter to existing files after diff, handle renames with `--diff-filter`, and skip submodule paths.
guidance: Verify each listed path exists and ends in `.rs` before scanning.
tests: Manual verification documented with a rename and delete case
security: Do not scan deleted or non-Rust paths.
